GOG announced it will give all STALKER owners a free DRM-free copy. You can reclaim it here. The keys for Call of Pripyat and Clear Sky can be easily accessed. The Shadow of Chernobyl key can be found in the registry**. When I copy that key on the GOG page it says it's invalid. Anyone knows what's up?

 

**open regedit and go to

HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\GSC Game World\STALKER-SHOC\InstallCDKEY

or on 64-bit machines

HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\GSC Game World\STALKER-SHOC\InstallCDKEY

 

UPDATE (GOG support responded): Please keep in mind that only keys from retail copies are supposed to work. That being said, we will do our best to keep updating our list of compatible codes, so please check back in the future to see if your code can be used. Unfortunately there is no way for us to add a game manually on a per-case basis. If the code doesn't work, we're unable to help - unless we secure a previously-unknown batch of codes and add it to the system.
